capabilities.why: Every command passes a code-level policy before the guest sees it (also registered as a Celesto Callback). Blocks rm -rf /, fork bombs, secret reads, egress and non-allowlisted installs; blocked attempts are still audited. A prompt sentence cannot do that.

A snapshot is taken before the risky step 7 so that a mid-task crash or a destructive command can be rolled back to a known-good guest instead of re-booting and re-installing from scratch; this is the rollback recovery policy.

The containment guest runs with internet mode off, so a prompt-injected exfiltration that slips past the hook (python urllib instead of curl) still cannot leave the microVM. Network policy is the second, independent layer.
